engine: ZEND_FUNCTION(exit) writes a string without changing EG(exit_status), while an integer replaces it. zend_objects_destroy_object protects the old UnwindExit during Child destruction; zend_exception_set_previous releases that old UnwindExit instead of chaining it when the Child exits again. zend_object_std_dtor and zend_objects_store_del continue later fields and retire the parent C pin. zend_error then restores the warning handler.
